comment: nice guy but super boring class. not hard just put in the work and ask him questions. he is really clear on what is expected of you.

A fantastic professor for OM, makes sure to provide many examples so you understand the material. Unfortunately, the class is really boring so the hardest part is staying awake most days. There are just a few core concepts to understand for exams, which he emphasizes in class.

Prof. Chen is great! His class was manageable because he explained every concept in detail and provided many in-class exercises. He's very accommodating and genuinely cares about student success. He gives clear grading instructions and effective explanations. Review the material given by him to do well

Professor Chen is one of the best professor's I've had at UofR. His MGMT340 class was a breeze because he always explained every concept in full detail, and we had a ton of in-class exercises to practice every type of problem. He's super accommodating if you need to take exams at different times, and is really kind and caring in general!
Very nice guy, but unclear at times. Grade is pretty much only the midterm and the final. His powerpoints are helpful, but wouldnt say hes the easiest option for OM.
Amazing professor and cares about his students' success.

Great prof, very nice. Clear grading instructions; few tests, quizzes, projects. Study his PowerPoints and practice problems and you will be fine. Available outside of class. Not a super exciting class, but he is the best prof for it; VERY clear and good at explaining things multiple ways. Def recommend.
